dataset_name: Centrally Protected Ticketed ASI Monuments Visitor Statistics
source_entity: Ministry of Tourism, Government of India & Archaeological Survey of India (ASI)
table_number: Table 4.2.3: Number of Visitors to Centrally Protected Ticketed Monuments, 2022-23 & 2023-24
reporting_period: Financial Years 2022-23 (1 April 2022 - 31 March 2023) and 2023-24 (1 April 2023 - 31 March 2024)
provenance_notes: Extracted from official Ministry of Tourism publications archived in data/raw/tourism/India_Tourism_Data_Compendium_2024.pdf. Sourced from ticketing records maintained by the Archaeological Survey of India (ASI) across 33 circles.

schema_fields.monument_name: Official monument name per Archaeological Survey of India
schema_fields.state_or_region: Standardized Indian State / Union Territory name

data_limitations: Covers centrally protected ticketed monuments under ASI jurisdiction only; does not include non-ticketed national monuments or state-protected monuments.
Reported on a financial year basis (April to March) rather than calendar years.
Monuments with temporary closures or transition to ticketless status contain legitimate null values (e.g., Mattancherry Palace Museum in 2023-24, Fort St. George in 2022-23).
